comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
For a time on GAMA server, three Ganador reward boxes (including this one) were available as a recipe at the Ganador Command Center that used broken cannons/armor/ripped sails for ingredients. But one day without warning, the recipe for all three boxes was removed and they've been unobtainable ever since.

All these years later on Maris, and the recipes have never returned. I keep hoping that if enough people were to contact PapayaPlay and ask them to lobby KOEI (politely) for the recipe's return, that might change. So far... nothing.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: There are at the moment English, Dutch and Turkish Admiral outfits for sell on a Company Shop in Seville, by this database those outfits can only be obtainable from this box. Any idea where they come from? thanks for the answer, didn't knew the recipe has been out since OGP, I thought was a Papaya thing. I've asked in-game but the answers are not satisfactory

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The above Admiral outfits can be obtained by defeating certain Ganadors. The drop rate is unknown but I'd say it is likely uncommon; certainly it isn't as rare or difficult as ship panels or storm sails, thankfully. I will try to add information related to each Ganador/Outfit to help fill in some more blank points on the UWO map. Cheers.
